description: Header file defining classes for network simulation links (OneWayLink and SymmetricLink) in the quic namespace, including methods for packet acceptance, bandwidth management, and link behavior.

classes.name: OneWayLink
classes.description: Represents a reliable simplex network link with constrained bandwidth and random delay, capable of accepting packets and scheduling their transmission.

classes.name: SymmetricLink
classes.description: Represents a full-duplex network link composed of two OneWayLink instances, allowing bidirectional communication.

methods.name: AcceptPacket
methods.description: Accepts a packet for transmission over the link.

methods.name: TimeUntilAvailable
methods.description: Returns the time until the link is available for sending another packet.

methods.name: Act
methods.description: Performs scheduled actions for the link, such as transmitting packets.

methods.name: set_bandwidth
methods.description: Sets the bandwidth of the link.
